name: Flashy Docs
description: Flashy Docs — a library on the FlashyOS mesh — an installable package with a hand-enumerated API and a release ledger. AAO expands to Agentic Autonomous Organization.

roles.name: maintainer
roles.purpose: Owns the library’s correctness and its public API. Removing an export is a major version; the API surface is enumerated by hand, never a generated snapshot.
roles.measure: Changes carrying a test, as a share of merges

roles.name: review
roles.purpose: Reviews a change before it lands, because a signature change breaks every consumer that embeds this package.
roles.measure: Merges carrying a review, as a share of merges

roles.name: release
roles.purpose: Versions and publishes to the registry, proving the package importable both ways before it ships and recording the release in the ledger.
roles.measure: Releases with a changelog entry, as a share of tags

roles.name: conformance
roles.purpose: Runs the tests, the typecheck and the lint, and holds coverage to the threshold CI fails on.
roles.measure: Checks passing, as a share of runs

roles.name: adoption
roles.purpose: Helps a consumer integrate and records real usage, so a claim of adoption is a number somebody measured rather than assumed.
roles.measure: Consumers onboarded, as a share of enquiries
